eyebrow.description: Layer label above a section head.

eyebrow-strong.description: The loud half of an eyebrow: the mark and the section name. Eyebrow is the quiet half after the slash.

quote.description: A pull quote inside a testimonial. Matches .tps-comment__quote: display face, medium weight, 18px.

badge.description: A small status badge on a tinted pill. Matches .tps-comment__resolved. Code asks for weight 800; Instrument Sans tops out at Bold in Figma.

hero.description: Hero headline. Fluid in code: clamp(44px, 5.4vw, 78px).

stat.description: A single large number. Matches .tps-stat__value: black weight, line height 1, tightest tracking. Fluid in code from 32px.

h1.description: Page title. Fluid in code: clamp(34px, 5vw, 58px).

h2.description: Section title. Fluid in code: clamp(24px, 3.4vw, 36px).

h3.description: Sub-section title. Fluid in code: clamp(22px, 3vw, 30px).

title.description: A card heading. Matches .tps-course__name: display face, bold, text-title, tracking-tight.

subtitle.description: A name or wordmark inside a component: the person on a testimonial, the mark in the nav and footer.

card.description: A heading at body size, for rows and list items. The FAQ question uses this.

xs.description: Dense UI text at 11.5. Matches .tps-optcard__detail: medium weight. For bold text at this size use UI/Tag.

tag.description: Chip label, sm. The status tag.

label-strong.description: Body-size UI text carrying weight: a meta line, a segment pill, a tier name. The most used style in the library.

md.description: Button label, md. Display face at body size. Line height stays auto, matching components.css which sets none.
A price in a row. Matches .tps-price-row__amount.

lg.description: A price on a tier card. Matches .tps-price__amount.

initials.description: Initials inside a comment pin or avatar. Heaviest weight because it sits on a saturated fill at small size.

float.description: Floating panel or modal. Two stops. --shadow-float.

75.description: Pale warm cream. The filled star in the evening-star icon. Off the round scale because the artwork uses it and snapping it to 50 would change the drawing.

300.description: The third rainbow band in the after-the-rain icon, inside sky/500 and sun/500.

line.description: Icon strokes and structure, 115 of the 155 marks in the set.

accent.description: Rain, water, the cool half of the sky motif.

warm.description: Sun and warmth, the gold half.

blush.description: One mark: the inner rainbow band in after-the-rain.

glow.description: One mark: the filled star in evening-star.

knockout.description: Not a colour so much as a hole. The handle in the properties icon is filled with the surface behind it so it reads as a knob on a track. Override it locally if an icon sits on the page or a sunk panel rather than a card.
